raw_segments.text: Not quite, you have secured the shadow of your thought, but no more probably.
You had not enough of the artist's skill and science to give it full being, yet the
drawings are, for a schoolgirl, peculiar.
As to the thoughts, they are elfish.
These eyes in the evening star you must have seen in a dream.
How could you make them look so clear, and yet not at all brilliant, for the planet above
And what meaning is that in their solemn depth, and who taught you to paint wind?
There is a high gale in that sky, and on this hilltop.
